entries.zh: 死者显灵、亡魂显现（玄神/显神）；天主教语境中亡灵的显现
entries.en: for the dead to appear, apparition of the dead (in catechetical/doctrinal context)
entries.notes: 汉字栏有[疑:玄/顯]，但西语 aparecerse el muerto 与对音 kiōy sîn 明确指向亡魂显现义。

entries.zh: 神迹般地显现；化身、显身
entries.en: to appear miraculously; incarnation, manifestation (of a deity)

entries.zh: 准备、陈设（筵席）；摆桌设席
entries.en: to prepare, dress, set out (a banquet, table)
entries.notes: 西语 Aparejar/componer/adereçar 为'备办陈设'义；闽南多音节 siêc siâng boi· 拆解依赖推断，汉字栏仅'筵'。

entries.zh: 预备、备办（器具齐备）
entries.en: to prepare, equip, furnish
entries.notes: 西语 aparejarlos para mechos（为筵席预备）与'具'互证，但原句有残断号，展开依赖上下文推断。

entries.zh: 备办齐全；为宴席预备（具备）
entries.en: to prepare as needed for a feast/invitation; to have ready
entries.notes: 第二字有[疑:備/倍]，按西语 convite 语境取'备'。

entries.zh: 排列、摆整齐
entries.en: to arrange, put in order

entries.zh: 排宴、设宴
entries.en: to prepare a banquet, lay out a feast

entries.zh: 排平疏密（排列均匀、疏密有致）；按等距排开
entries.en: to lay out evenly, spacing things (sparse and dense) regularly
entries.notes: 第四字有[疑:疏/踈]；西语原句 'aparejarlos si este ygual' 拼写残损，释义按'排平疏密'直解。

entries.zh: 辨（办）、备办
entries.en: to prepare, arrange, get ready

entries.zh: 辨茶、备茶（沏茶待客）
entries.en: to prepare tea

entries.zh: 辨便、备便（把要用的东西办妥）
entries.en: to prepare what is needed, have things ready

entries.zh: 辨未便（尚未备妥；已备而未全）
entries.en: prepared but not yet fully/completely ready

entries.zh: 设、设置安排
entries.en: to set up, arrange, prepare

entries.zh: 设席（摆设筵席）
entries.en: to lay a table, set out a banquet (席席/mat)

entries.zh: 设桌（摆酒席、下帖子请客）；设桌请客
entries.en: to set a table, prepare a feast; to invite (to a banquet)

entries.zh: 备（备好、有准备）；备办
entries.en: prepared, ready; to prepare
entries.notes: 汉字有[疑:備/倍]，按西语 aparejar/aparejado 取'备'。

entries.zh: 备辨、备办（各样东西预备齐）
entries.en: to prepare, provide any/whatever thing is needed
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:備/倍]，按语境取'备'。

entries.zh: 便（方便、就绪）；料理妥当
entries.en: convenient, ready; to put in order, make ready

entries.zh: 便益（有好处、得利、便利）
entries.en: beneficial, advantageous, profitable; convenience

entries.zh: 遇便（碰巧遇上便利、凑巧得便）
entries.en: to happen upon an occasion/convenience, by chance find it convenient

entries.zh: 安排桌（摆设筵席、备办宴席）
entries.en: to arrange a table/feast, prepare a celebration

entries.zh: 安排酒（备办喜酒、婚宴）
entries.en: to prepare wine-feast, arrange a wedding banquet
entries.notes: source_R 第三音节 T99（污損难辨），按汉字'酒'与闽南对音 chiū 取'备办酒宴'义。
